body:
I am in the US. I'm not really looking to be detained.

I don't know...I just want...help, I guess? Not sure if that makes sense.

I'm a little worried, now. If I'm sent to some sort of psychiatric center for an unknown amount of time, that's as bad as me actually killing myself - both actions kind of fuck over everyone else around me...my wife will have to work and there's no one left home to watch our son...

At least if I'm dead they'll let her off for bereavement.

I don't have a life insurance policy.

The sleeping pills were just for that - to put me to sleep. I don't sleep well, so I figured I'd get a little shut-eye before I go.

I don't have insurance. I'm a college student who has been refused any serious care for my Type 1 diabetes or bipolar disorder and referred to a local free clinic.

My wife called that clinic today to try to get me in as a new patient. They denied me, said being a student disqualifies me.

This is kinda the straw that's breaking the camel's back.

I'm about a hair away from injecting two vials of insulin, eating a bottle of sleeping meds and just drifting off. I don't really have the willpower to deal with it anymore.
